rationale: The fatal Node WebAssembly compilation assertion in the renderer supports V8 or Node integration; broader startup/webcontents labels are plausible. The Actual Behavior section supplies an Electron Fiddle gist and asks to run it on 42.4.0. The empty dedicated field does not nullify the explicit gist elsewhere. Stack traces alone are not runnable code. No retrieved startup/MAS crash shares the specific node::wasm_web_api::StartStreamingCompilation assertion !impl.IsEmpty(). A Node assertion inside an Electron renderer does not prove a standalone Node defect. This is an Electron regression report, not merely a complaint about the named application.
